caption:
Someone just launched a free dashboard similar to the ones governments use for surveillance.

It’s called World Monitor.

You can open it in your browser and see what’s happening around the globe in real time. 

You can even filter the dashboard by any region you’re interested in.

Toggle between multiple layers to track military activity, explore global trade routes, or monitor natural disasters such as earthquakes and wildfires detected by NASA satellites.

There’s also a panel for live webcams and broadcasts, where you can watch multiple news channels. 
But here’s the craziest part!

There are six different versions of the dashboard, including World Monitor, Tech Monitor, Finance Monitor, and even Happy Monitor, which only shows positive news from around the world.

You can also connect World Monitor to Claude or ChatGPT to investigate events further.

If you want the link to World Monitor, it’s pinned in the comments section.
